name: Northshire Vineyards
summary: East of Northshire Abbey, Northshire Vineyards are in Defias hands. Their grapes once supplied wine to the clerics, but thieves now plunder the harvest and threaten local farmers.

sections.title: A Plundered Harvest
sections.body:
Across the stream from Northshire Abbey, local workers once tended the grape fields. Milly Osworth was among them. Now Garrick Padfoot leads the Defias Brotherhood brigands who hold the acreage.

The vineyards give newly arrived Brotherhood recruits an easy foothold close to the abbey. The Defias presence has reached its fields.

faq.q: Who controls the Northshire Vineyards right now?
faq.answer: Defias Brotherhood thieves and cutthroats occupy Northshire Vineyards. Garrick Padfoot leads them as they plunder the crops and terrorize local workers.

faq.q: Why is the abbey letting bandits run rampant in the fields?
aliases: why isn't the abbey defending the vineyards
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin while King Varian Wrynn is missing. Abbey guards protect the abbey and watch the valley roads, so local farmers depend on newly arrived adventurers to recover their stolen goods.
Milly Osworth is a local farmer who worked the vineyards. When the Defias bandits seized the grape harvest, they drove her away. She now asks travelers to recover her stolen crates.

angles.text: For many young humans setting out into the world, the occupied vineyards offer a first encounter with the Defias Brotherhood's reach and the bitterness it brings.
Unrest in these quiet grape fields shows how far lawlessness has spread, reaching even the most protected corners of the kingdom of Stormwind.
